jobs.description:

Wealthsimple is Canada’s leading financial innovator. The company offers a full suite of simple, sophisticated financial products across managed investing, do-it-yourself trading, cryptocurrency, tax filing, spending and saving. Wealthsimple currently serves more than 4 million Canadians and holds over $155 billion in assets under administration. The company was founded in 2014 by a team of financial experts and technology entrepreneurs, and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.



We're proud of what we've built — and we're just getting started. Read our Culture Manual https://www.wealthsimple.com/en-ca/culture and learn more about how we work https://www.wealthsimple.com/en-ca/careers.




ABOUT THE TEAM:

The Corporate Development function at Wealthsimple is a small but high-impact team responsible for accelerating the company’s growth through mergers & acquisitions, strategic investments, and strategic partnerships. We’re looking for someone who can seamlessly swing between corporate strategy projects to identify avenues for scalable growth and tactical deal execution to catalyze our highest priorities. You will work with product, engineering, and business leadership to identify, evaluate, and execute on inorganic growth opportunities that give our company access to best-in-class product, technology, and talent.  You will own the development of rigorous analyses to evaluate build / buy / partner scenarios with the goal of providing strategic recommendations to the leadership team. This is a great role for someone who is an innovative thinker and wants to help bend the company’s growth trajectory.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU'LL HAVE THE OPPORTUNITY TO:

 - Partner with leaders across the company to identify strategic opportunities that can accelerate our product roadmap and business strategy

 - Be a subject matter expert on the competitive landscape and industry trends; leverage your market insights to develop the business case for growth opportunities via product expansion or partnership distribution strategies

 - Lead qualitative and quantitative analyses including build / buy / partner considerations, financial forecasting, and valuation modeling

 - Manage all stages of a deal process - including inbound / outbound sourcing, deal assessment, valuation, negotiations, due diligence, structuring, closing processes, and post-deal integration - while coordinating across a large cross-functional team

 - Collaborate and build relationships with internal stakeholders across all functions and seniority levels, as well as with external parties in our ecosystem (VCs, founders, investment banks, etc.)
   
   


WE'RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO HAS:

 - 7+ years of relevant work experience in corporate development, investment banking, venture capital, or private equity

 - Proactive ownership mindset and can thrive in a dynamic, fast paced environment

 - Passion for high growth tech, FinTech, and traditional FinServices

 - Ability to think strategically and leverage a combination of critical thinking, intellectual curiosity, business judgment, and product intuition

 - Demonstrated problem-solving skills, with exceptional ability to create structured quantitative and qualitative analyses

 - Superior financial modeling and valuation skills (including DCF, comps analysis, etc.)

 - High EQ and interpersonal skills to cultivate relationships internally and externally

 - Ability to balance multiple high-priority projects and collaborate / coordinate across large cross-functional teams

 - Strong communication skills (verbal + written) and can deliver insights around complex business problems in a thoughtful and persuasive manner

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Growth Manager to own performance and lifecycle marketing for our active trader and crypto business. This role runs the programs that grow our self-directed trading and crypto segment - acquiring high-intent traders and crypto investors through the channels they live in, converting them into funded active traders, and deepening engagement through lifecycle across the trades, products, and benefits that drive volume and revenue.


You'll own paid media and lifecycle end-to-end, from media buys on trader and crypto-native channels through in-app journeys that turn a new account into an active, funded trader. You'll partner closely with Product, Product Marketing, Lifecycle, Sales/BDR, and Analytics; operate with a high degree of day-to-day autonomy; and be accountable for funded active-trader and crypto engagement outcomes.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own active trader and crypto demand generation across the channels traders and crypto investors live in — paid social (X/Twitter, Cashtags), trading platforms (TradingView), finance and crypto media (Yahoo Finance), trading and crypto newsletters, SEM, and influencers/community — measured through to funded accounts and sustained trading activity, not clicks.

 - Own the media buys end to end — plan and manage budgets, negotiate placements and rates with vendors, run creative and landing-page testing, and diagnose what's working (reactivation vs. acquisition, channel vs. landing page) rather than just reporting spend.

 - Own the trader and crypto lifecycle alongside Lifecycle and Product — activation, first-trade, funding, and "nearly active" re-engagement journeys across Braze content cards, AT status screens, and rewards. Bring performance and LCM best practices to how these journeys are built, even where you're not hands-on-keyboard for every send.

 - Drive go-to-market for active trader and crypto products and benefits — options, futures, margin, USD, and crypto (spread pricing, coin selection, staking) — coordinating paid, lifecycle, web, and product surfaces into a single launch, and owning the brief end to end.

 - Build and maintain clear reporting across the trader and crypto funnel — first touch through sign-up, funding, first trade, and retained trading value. Partner with Analytics on incrementality and true lift, and make clear recommendations on where to double down, test, or pull back.

 - Run a consistent testing cadence across creative, audiences, offers, and landing pages, and turn what you learn into repeatable programs.

 - Actively embed AI tools into performance and lifecycle workflows — creative and copy iteration, audience research, landing page iteration, and campaign experimentation.

 - Contribute to the quarterly plan alongside other Growth leads, then own delivery against it.
   


WHAT YOU BRING

 - 4–6 years in performance marketing, growth, or lifecycle marketing with a track record of generating high-quality consumer demand and optimizing it through to downstream value.

 - Deep hands-on experience in paid media — you've owned budgets and managed campaigns across platforms like Google, Meta, X, YouTube, or programmatic, negotiated with vendors, and optimized for downstream value rather than cost per click.

 - Lifecycle marketing depth — you've built or owned activation, onboarding, nurture, or re-engagement journeys and understand how lifecycle compounds the demand you generate. Hands-on with a lifecycle platform (Braze, Iterable, HubSpot, or similar) is strongly preferred; at minimum you bring the best practices and can direct the work.

 - Experience marketing to engaged, high-intent audiences who know the product and compare it closely to alternatives — you understand how messaging, channel mix, and creative shift for that kind of buyer.

 - Strong cross-functional partnering — you've worked closely with Product and Analytics (segment definitions, funnel diagnosis, incrementality) and Product Marketing (messaging, GTM briefs), and made those relationships an advantage.

 - A demonstrated habit of using AI to accelerate your work — creative at scale, research and enrichment workflows, faster insight from data. You treat AI as a core part of how you work.

 - Analytical mindset — you use data to diagnose funnel problems, prioritize opportunities, and recommend change, not just report on results.
   


NICE TO HAVES:

 - Personal or professional familiarity with self-directed investing, active trading, or crypto — options, margin, futures, high-frequency trading, or digital assets — and the platforms and communities traders live in (X/FinTwit, TradingView, trading and crypto newsletters, YouTube).

 - A growth and acquisition orientation. You've turned partnerships or campaigns into measurable client acquisition, online and in person, and you think in funnels, not just relationships.

 - Channel or referral partnership experience. You've built or run a referral or channel pipeline that produced real, attributable results.

 - Strong analytical and commercial skills, with real comfort in CAC, LTV, and attribution.

 - A strong network in Canada (and ideally the US) across relevant commercial, tech, and community ecosystems.

jobs.description:
BUILD SOMETHING PEOPLE LOVE

Wealthsimple is Canada’s leading financial innovator. The company offers a full suite of simple, sophisticated financial products across managed investing, do-it-yourself trading, cryptocurrency, tax filing, spending and saving. Wealthsimple currently serves more than 4 million Canadians and holds over $155 billion in assets under administration. The company was founded in 2014 by a team of financial experts and technology entrepreneurs, and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.



We're proud of what we've built — and we're just getting started. Read our Culture Manual https://www.wealthsimple.com/en-ca/culture and learn more about how we work https://www.wealthsimple.com/en-ca/careers.




INTERN, CLIENT EXPERIENCE STRATEGY & OPERATIONS (WINTER 2027)

Location: Toronto, ON (Hybrid)

Term: 8 months, beginning January 11, 2027. 



This is an 8 month internship designed for co-op students, non-co-op students, and recent graduates who are ready to ship impactful work.

During your internship, you will have the opportunity to contribute to projects that are changing the landscape of financial services for Canadians. You will be on a team that supports your growth, provides mentorship, and connects you to the broader Wealthsimple community!

Our internship program operates on a hybrid model, where you’ll be working from our Toronto headquarters on Wednesdays and Thursdays. This structure offers the flexibility of remote work, while also providing the collaboration, connection, and mentorship that come from being together in person.



This posting covers two tracks: Workflow Optimization and Enablement. Please apply to the one that best fits your interests.

Please note: the role you apply for is the role you will be assessed on throughout the interview process. We are unable to accommodate requests to switch between Workflow Optimization and Enablement tracks after submission.



 


ABOUT THE CX OPERATIONS TEAM

The CX Operations team is responsible for enabling exceptional client and agent experiences across Wealthsimple through optimized systems, content, AI solutions, and strategic initiatives. We manage the technology, knowledge, and processes that power our customer experience organization, driving continuous improvement in efficiency and effectiveness.

 


CHOOSE YOUR TRACK:

 


WORKFLOW OPTIMIZATION, INTERN

Workflow Optimization (WFO) streamlines the workflows, systems, and automations that span our entire ecosystem of tools. We partner with teams across the organization to identify and simplify toilsome workflows through process mapping, automation, and AI tool implementations.

As a WFO Intern, you'll partner with WFO managers and internal SMEs to: design and build AI tools for analysis; audit and improve automations; map and redesign workflows; and deliver measurable improvements in containment, resolution time, and operational risk.

You'll develop core skills in project planning, process design, AI tool deployment, and AI‑enhanced automation while contributing directly to CX efficiency and client experience.

 


IN THIS ROLE, YOU’LL HAVE THE OPPORTUNITY TO

 - Partner with the AI Experiences team to launch net-new features to our clients and support agents.

 - Map current-state workflows with SMEs, identify optimization opportunities, and implement AI-enhanced changes across macros, automations, and documentation.

 - Build comprehensive automation inventories across multiple systems, to propose consolidations and net-new automations and AI optimizations.


WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - Structured problem solving and process thinking, with the ability to translate ambiguous workflows into clear maps and requirements

 - Basic familiarity with AI concepts (LLM, RAG, context windows, hallucination, etc.)

 - Basic familiarity with customer operations tools or ticketing systems (Zendesk, JIRA)

 - Basic familiarity with data and testing concepts – to be applied in the context of testing the accuracy of AI models (A/B testing, sample sizes, statistical significance, etc.)

 - Strong documentation and communication skills to collaborate with SMEs and present proposals

 - Bias to action and ownership to drive projects from discovery to implementation







ENABLEMENT, INTERN

Our enablement group is responsible for how our support workforce learns, performs, and grows. We build the systems, programs, and culture that keep our support teams performing at a high bar. Quality, learning, change readiness, and performance measurement all sit within this group. Underneath all of it is a simple belief: every client interaction should be fast, high-quality, and trustworthy. Our job is to turn that belief into measurable reality.

As an Enablement Intern, you'll support the group's analytical work. You'll partner with the managers who own quality and performance measurement to test the data, run original analyses, spot trends early, and turn your findings into recommendations leaders can act on. This goes beyond reporting, the question is never only "what does the number say?" It's also "is this measuring the right thing, and what should we do about it?"

You'll build skills in analysis, metric design, and structured problem solving, and see up close how an AI-first quality and performance program runs in a regulated industry. The best person for this role doesn't only meet a high bar; they hold their own work to one.

 


IN THIS ROLE, YOU’LL HAVE THE OPPORTUNITY TO

 - Design and run trending analyses across scorecard metrics to inform target reviews, and build a repeatable way of doing them so each review doesn't start from scratch

 - Look for relationships between metrics, such as how quality, satisfaction and efficiency move together, and turn what you find into clear charts and recommendations

 - Help define and document metrics: what each one measures, where its data comes from, and where two metrics overlap or one is only raw input to another

 - Build checks and first-pass reviews that help the team catch errors in scorecards and reports before they’re finalized

 - Support analysis of quality data, such as sampling and summarizing results, as projects call for it


WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - Strong quantitative and spreadsheet skills, and comfort cleaning, joining and pivoting messy data (SQL is a plus)

 - An understanding of how relational data fits together (tables, keys, joins). SQL is a plus but not required

 - Experience building trend analyses and visualizations, and the judgment to tell a real pattern from noise

 - Basic familiarity with statistical concepts like correlation, sample sizes and significance

 - Basic familiarity with ticketing tools and support systems, and where support data comes from

 - Structured problem solving: you can turn a vague question into a hypothesis, an analysis and a clear "so what"

 - Clear writing, including explaining a finding to the person who has to act on it

 - Ownership and a bias to action, taking work from question to recommendation




ELIGIBILITY

✔ Currently enrolled as a student at a Canadian post-secondary institution or technical bootcamp

✔ New graduates - Within 6 months of your graduation date

✔ Available to work full-time hours

✔ Residing in Canada

✔ Able to commute to our Toronto HQ on Wednesdays and Thursdays

 


COMPENSATION & EQUITY

🤑 Base salary range: For this role, candidates can expect the following base salary range:

• Term 1 students: CAD $42,000 - $44,000

• Term 2 students: CAD $44,000 - $46,000

• Term 3 students: CAD $46,000 - $48,000

• Term 4 students: CAD $48,000 - $50,000

• Term 5 students: CAD $49,000 - $52,000

 

Your current year of study and number of past internship terms will determine your salary band. Actual compensation within each band is based on skills, experience, and academic performance. Exceptional candidates may be considered above the top of their year's range. 🚀
